description: Binance aggTrades (aggregated trade prints), daily csv.gz per UTC day, for P2-08b (docs/PHASE2/P2-08b/PREREG.md, second-scale Binance-leads-bitFlyer propagation study). Spot BTCUSDT is the primary signal source for the 2026-07-23..2026-09-06 window; USDT-margined perpetual (futures/um) BTCUSDT over the same window is a contrast source (BLINDSPOT_AUDIT.md #5, not the selection signal); a third directory holds spot aggTrades for the same 85 specific days as the Tardis free-sample bitFlyer trades (docs/PHASE2/P2-08b/TARDIS_SAMPLES.md), for the long-term propagation diagnostic.
source: https://data.binance.vision/data/{spot,futures/um}/daily/aggTrades/BTCUSDT/BTCUSDT-aggTrades-YYYY-MM-DD.zip (public, unauthenticated, S3-backed static dump maintained by Binance). Fetched by scripts/fetch_binance_vision.py --kind aggTrades (--market spot or --market um). SHA-256 .CHECKSUM verified per zip before use (see the script).
retention: permanent, dated snapshot -- reproducibility archive, not appended forward. One csv.gz per UTC calendar day, never a concatenated multi-day file (unlike this repo's klines convention) since aggTrades volume makes a single multi-month file unwieldy and P2-08b's per-day gap/overlap analysis wants day boundaries preserved.

agg_id.meaning: Binance aggregated-trade id (monotonic increasing, unique per symbol+market)

price.notes: kept as the source string, not re-typed to float, to avoid FP rounding of exchange-quoted decimals

first_id.meaning: first underlying raw trade id folded into this aggregate

last_id.meaning: last underlying raw trade id folded into this aggregate

ts_us.meaning: exchange timestamp, normalized to UTC microseconds
ts_us.notes: Binance Vision aggTrades timestamps are milliseconds through 2024-12-31 and microseconds from 2025-01-01 onward (see github.com/binance/binance-public-data README) -- fetch_binance_vision.py's normalize_to_us() detects and normalizes both to microseconds so every file in this dataset uses one unit. This window (2026) is natively microseconds already.

is_buyer_maker.meaning: true if the buyer was the resting (maker) side, i.e. a sell-initiated (taker-sell) print; false if taker-buy
is_buyer_maker.notes: spot dumps ship an extra is_best_match column (best-price-match flag) which is dropped here -- not part of this registered schema, and not present at all in futures/um dumps

known_defects: spot vs futures/um are separate markets with independent agg_id sequences -- do not compare agg_id across the two directories, only ts_us/price
futures/um (USDT-margined perpetual) is a CONTRAST source only in P2-08b -- not used for the study's primary signal or selection (BLINDSPOT_AUDIT.md #5)

the *_tardis_days directory covers only the 85 specific first-of-month UTC days matched to data/tardis/bitflyer_FX_BTC_JPY_trades/ (diagnostic-only, long-term propagation timeline) -- it is NOT a contiguous window and must not be treated as one

row counts vary by roughly 10x across the 2026-07-23..2026-09-06 window depending on volatility/volume that day -- an empty or sparse day is not necessarily a fetch failure, cross-check against the corresponding 1s klines volume column
